messages:
Ivy Morales: quick sanity check on the rule preview in staging. On a 14" laptop the preview panel is pushed off-screen when there are 6 channels + a long rule description. Screenshot: https://.../preview-overflow.png :frowning:
Sam Becker: saw it. Two options: allow the preview to float over the list (z-index) or collapse overflow into a "+N channels" toggle. Floating feels unpredictable for keyboard users.
Rohit Singh: accessibility note: if we use a toggle, it must be reachable and announceable. aria-expanded on the toggle + a single polite live message like "Additional channels shown: 3" when opened. Avoid announcing each item.
Ivy Morales: copy question: current label is "Mute window" in one place and "Quiet window" elsewhere. can we standardize on "Quiet window (ends)"? people in tests responded better to that phrasing.
Sam Becker: spacing tweak: rather than increasing vertical padding globally, try a compact row variant for rule lists (smaller input heights, reduced chrome). keeps the preview visible without sacrificing touch targets.
Rohit Singh: keyboard flow: when you tab into the collapsed "+N" control, Enter should open the list and focus the first channel. Escape closes and returns focus to the "+N" control. Also announce reorder moves: "Slack moved to position 2."
DesignBot: snapshot 1829990001-preview generated  result: WARN (contrast 1 fail, focus-order 1 warn)
accessibility-bot: suggestion: use filled channel pills with white text at 600 weight to pass contrast at 14px; update token --badge-contrast to 4.5:1.
Ivy Morales: okI'll consolidate copy to "Quiet window (ends)" and mock the compact row. Sam, can you prototype the collapsed channels toggle behavior? Rohit, would you take the aria-live / keyboard ticket?
Sam Becker: yep, I'll prototype today and add keyboard notes.
Rohit Singh: filing DESIGN-1242 for toggle aria + announce, and DESIGN-1243 for keyboard reorder announcements. cc @Ivy @Sam :white_check_mark:
Ivy Morales: moving this to design-review. thanks team! :tada:
